environment.description: ECS Fargate service with origin access restricted via security group allowing inbound only from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). CloudFront distribution configured with signed URL requirement using RSA-2048 key pair (Key Group ID: kg-a4f29c81) on all behaviors (/*). Distribution has Origin Request Policy 'Managed-AllViewerExceptHostHeader' (ID: b689b0a8-53d0-40ab-baf2-68738e2966ac) which explicitly strips the Host header from origin requests and does NOT forward X-Forwarded-Host. CloudFront cache policy uses only path and query string as cache key components (no header-based keying). Viewer protocol policy: HTTPS only. Origin protocol: HTTPS only with TLSv1.2 minimum.

config.cloudfront_cache_policy: path + query string only, no headers
config.redis: ElastiCache cluster, shared across all tasks
